def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    available = bins - (bins > 0) * 1e-10  # Avoid division by zero; assume bins are non-negative
    # Prioritize bins with more available space, but avoid overflow
    priorities = available / (bins + 1e-10)  # Normalize by bin capacity to prevent bias toward large bins
    # Penalize bins where adding the item would exceed capacity
    overflow_mask = available < item
    priorities[overflow_mask] = 0
    return priorities
